summary: Market tone looks cautiously bullish for select crypto names, with Miles Deutscher highlighting concentrated quality and strong flow among a small set of revenue-generating protocols, while Degen Dave continues to frame several altcoins as active trade setups. For macro, the available sources are too thin for a confident same-day read on equities, FX, gold, or Brent, so those are marked mostly neutral.
